h1: The Resort Kabinburi, Prachinburi — A New Roadside Resort on Route 304 with Spacious, Clean Rooms Under ฿700
intro: If you are driving through Kabin Buri on Highway 304 and want a clean, spacious room with easy parking for a few hundred baht — The Resort Kabinburi is a newly opened resort that many travellers leave pleasantly surprised by. It is a 3-star property that opened in 2023 in Mueang Kao subdistrict, right on Route 304, with 30 bungalow-style rooms that come with a sit-out balcony and parking next to your door. What real guests mention most often is that the rooms are spacious and clean and the Wi-Fi is strong enough to work or stream on. Rates start from around ฿450/night, nudging up a little for larger beds or long-weekend dates.

body.html: The appeal of The Resort Kabinburi is its simplicity done right for people passing through. It opened in 2023, so everything still feels new and clean. It sits on Highway 304 in Mueang Kao subdistrict, Kabin Buri, close to restaurants and petrol stations. That makes it a natural one-night stop for anyone driving from Bangkok towards Isan or Khao Yai — you turn off the main road and you are at your door, with no long side lanes to navigate.

All 30 rooms are bungalow-style with a sit-out balcony and parking right outside the door. Inside you get air conditioning, a flat-screen TV, a fridge and an en-suite bathroom with a shower. What real reviews agree on is that the rooms are larger than you would expect at this price, simply and neatly decorated, and the water pressure in the bathroom is good. Having the car parked in front of the room makes loading and unloading easy, which self-drivers especially appreciate.
"Spacious, clean room, park right outside the door, very strong Wi-Fi so I could work easily, quiet and relaxing, friendly staff — great value for a stopover on the road."

The Wi-Fi comes up again and again in reviews. Several guests say the signal is strong enough to work, game or stream without dropping, which is not a given at this price point. On top of that there is an on-site convenience store, a 24-hour front desk that holds luggage, and bicycles you can borrow to ride around. The overall mood is quiet and restful — better suited to a one-night stopover than to a full day of on-site activities.

To be clear, The Resort Kabinburi is a simple, no-frills place, not a luxury resort with a pool or spa. There is no breakfast service, so the morning meal means heading out or grabbing something from the convenience store. The upside is that Route 304 nearby has plenty of restaurants and coffee shops within a short drive. The in-room amenities cover everything you need for a night's sleep, but if you want a property with activities or full-service facilities, look elsewhere.

One honest note from the reviews concerns the bed. A few guests mention the mattress is on the firm side, which is a matter of personal taste. If you like a firm bed you will be fine; if you prefer something soft it may feel a touch hard. Beyond that, the feedback skews positive — cleanliness, room size and friendly staff all earn praise. Because it is a new resort with only a handful of rooms, the volume of online reviews is still small, but the scores it does have are solid.

Overall, The Resort Kabinburi holds a real-review score of about 8.8 on Trip.com and 4.5 out of 5 on Tripadvisor, standing out for service, cleanliness and an easy-to-find roadside location. Rates start around ฿450–650 for a standard room, rising a little for larger beds or long weekends. If you want a clean, spacious room with easy parking and strong Wi-Fi for a few hundred baht — whether as a road stopover or while doing business in Kabin Buri — this place delivers exactly that.

A tip from following the reviews here: if you are using it as a road stopover, call ahead to confirm the check-in time, as some platforms list it slightly differently. And if you want the quietest room, ask for one set back from the road to avoid traffic noise from Route 304.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — The Resort Kabinburi, Prachinburi

faq.q: Where is The Resort Kabinburi in Prachinburi, and what is nearby?
faq.a: The Resort Kabinburi is at 678/1 Moo 8, Mueang Kao, Kabin Buri District, Prachinburi · a roadside resort on Highway 304, close to restaurants and petrol stations · about 2 km from Chaloem Ratchaya Park, Kabin Buri, and around 5 km from Kabin Buri Hospital · very easy to find since you turn off the main road straight to your door.

faq.q: How much does The Resort Kabinburi cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rates start from about ฿450/night for a standard double · options run from double and twin rooms up to a Superior with a larger bed and a family room · prices rise a little by room type and on long weekends, so compare a few platforms before you book.

faq.q: Does The Resort Kabinburi have breakfast or a swimming pool?
faq.a: Neither. The Resort Kabinburi is a simple place built for a road stopover, with no breakfast service and no swimming pool · however, Route 304 nearby has several restaurants and coffee shops within a short drive, and there is an on-site convenience store at the resort.

faq.q: What are the rooms at The Resort Kabinburi like, and is the Wi-Fi good?
faq.a: Rooms are bungalow-style with a balcony and door-side parking, with AC, a flat-screen TV, a fridge and an en-suite bathroom · real reviews praise the spacious, clean rooms and good water pressure, and say the Wi-Fi is strong enough to work, game or stream without dropping · a few guests note the mattress runs firm for those who prefer a soft bed.

faq.q: Who is The Resort Kabinburi best for?
faq.a: It suits self-drivers passing through Kabin Buri who want a one-night stop, or anyone doing business in the area who wants a clean, spacious room with easy parking and strong Wi-Fi on a budget · being a simple property with no pool or activities, it works better as a road stopover than for a long, leisurely stay.

faq.q: Does The Resort Kabinburi have parking, and how long has it been open?
faq.a: Yes · there is free parking right outside every room for easy loading · it is a newly opened resort from 2023, so everything still feels new and clean, with 30 rooms, an on-site convenience store and a front desk that holds luggage.
